name: images_retouch
description: Edit ONE region of an image, leaving the rest untouched. `maskCreationIdentifier` is a black/white mask the same size as the image: white marks the region to change. mode `replace` needs a `prompt` describing the result; `erase` removes what is masked. Whole-image sharpness/quality: `images_upscale`. Extend canvas/free space: `images_expand`. Whole-image creative rework only: `images_generate` with a reference.

editType.description: `precise` keeps every pixel outside the mask; `creative` may regenerate the whole frame. Steers Auto; a named `model` must list it in `retouchTypes`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

maskCreationIdentifier.description: Mask creation identifier. Same pixel size as the image; white = change, black = keep.

mode.description: `replace` generates from `prompt`; `erase` removes the masked region. Default replace.

model.description: A slug from retouch_models_list whose `retouchModes` includes `mode`. Omit (or `auto`) to let Auto pick.

prompt.description: What the masked region should become. Required for `replace`.

resolution.description: One of the model's `resolutions` in retouch_models_list. Omit for its `defaultResolution`; models without `resolutions` take none.
